name: opportunity-os
description: Documentation-first engineering foundation for Opportunity OS.

scripts.lint: node scripts/verify-repository.mjs --phase review && turbo run lint
scripts.build: node scripts/verify-repository.mjs --phase review && turbo run build
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-repository.mjs --phase review && node --test scripts/verify-hosted-release.test.mjs scripts/verify-production-readiness.test.mjs && turbo run test --concurrency=1 -- --testTimeout=90000
scripts.benchmark:quality:clustered: pnpm --filter @opportunity-os/opportunity-pipeline build && pnpm --filter @opportunity-os/opportunity-generation build && pnpm --filter @opportunity-os/opportunity-ranking build && node scripts/opportunity-quality-benchmark.mjs evaluate-clustered
